Name: (CP_FS) Jedone's Casual Hat Pack
Author: Jed0ne
Description:
[center][size=6]
[b][color=#a4c2f4]Jedone's Casual Hat Pack *☆+[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][size=4]Adds 30 hats to your game, available in both Fashion Sense and Content Patcher formats.[/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=5][b]✪ Includes ✪[/b][/size][/center]
[center][size=4]Officer Cap[/size][/center]
[center][size=4]Backwards Cap (5 colors)[/size][/center]
[center][size=4]Trapper Hat (2 colors)[/size][/center]
[center][size=4]Cap & Headphones (8 colors)[/size][/center]
[center][size=4]Vintage Cap (3 colors)[/size][/center]
[center][size=4]Cat Headphones (3 colors)[/size][/center]
[center][size=4]Fluffy Beanie (3 colors)[/size][/center]
[center][size=4]Hair Kerchief (5 colors)[/size][/center]
[center]

[line]

[/center]
[center][size=5][b]✪ Installation ✪[/b][/size][/center]
[center][size=4]Ensure you have the latest version of the required mods installed[/size][/center]
[center][size=4]([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 2.0.0+ / [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] 7.5.0+),[/size][/center]
[center][size=4]then unzip and place the desired folder(s) into your Mods folder.[/size][/center]
[center][size=4]You can use both versions at the same time, or just one.[/size]
[/center]
[center][size=5][b]✪ How to get items(CP Version) ✪[/b][/size][/center]
[center][size=4]Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url] and search [color=#9fc5e8][b]"JD"[/b][/color] to find all hats from this pack.

[/size]
[line]
[/center]
[center]
[size=5][b]✪ Permissions ✪[/b][/size][/center]
[center][size=4][b]Personal edits are allowed. Redistribution is not permitted.
[/b][/size][/center]
[center][b][size=5]✪ Credits ✪[/size][/b][/center]
[center][size=4][b]CP clothing template by 델로티.

[/b][/size][/center]
